Cash Check

Revenue Cash: Guest Charges Summary's own Cash column, grouped by the room-night's date. Report Cash: every Cash payment in the system, grouped by the date it was actually received. These use two different meanings of "date" on purpose — a night paid off later will land on different rows in each column.

Miscellaneous

Every Miscellaneous charge (Snooker, BBQ, Bonfire, Mattress) billed through guest entries — nothing else, no room-nights. Amounts are the billed charge on the entry, listed by the guest's check-in date.

Settings

Admin tools and data/sync controls

⚠ Delete Entity

Remove an accidentally created entry — admin only. This is a soft delete: the entry (with its rooms and payments) disappears from every screen immediately. Nothing is destroyed — an admin can still restore it directly in the Supabase SQL Editor — but there is no Undo button inside the app, so search carefully and confirm you have the right guest.
